candidates.hook: An operative steps from the misty forest and bows deferentially to Alexander, addressing him: "Your Grace."
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander clenches his fist in fury upon hearing his mother is captive and rivals stole his seat, but the clip cuts right when his informant asks: "And when we have the proof?"
candidates.why: It delivers the explosive identity reveal that this scarred common soldier is actually a Duke, followed immediately by high-stakes usurpation drama.

moments.desc: A mysterious agent bows in the fog, addressing Alexander as 'Your Grace' before Alexander demands an update on Ashburg.
Alexander learns his mother is a prisoner and that everyone believes he is dead, resolving to let them believe it.
Alexander delivers a cold promise of vengeance: 'Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.'
Juliana clutches her scorched herbal ledger amidst the smoking ruins of their home, mourning its destruction.
